about: A turn waits on an approval and the app is quit and started again with no record of the ask: the server sends the unanswered request again to the new client, so the approval card comes back and the thread is said to need you, and once the app is started again and Enter answers it the command runs and nothing says the approval was lost.

absent_texts: This approval was lost when the app quit. Yi is still waiting on it, and Stop does not free it: the run stays held until yi serve restarts.
